# BTC Bridge

> BTC Bridge is a non-custodial interface for moving native BTC from the Bitcoin network to EVM chains such as Ethereum and Arbitrum as a wrapped BTC token, and back. Users sign from their own Bitcoin and EVM wallets; the interface never holds funds. It explains custodial and threshold-bridged models, fees and risks.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Native BTC stays on the Bitcoin network; the EVM chain receives a wrapped token that represents it.
- Every BTC-to-EVM bridge depends on a custodian, federation or threshold signer network holding the locked BTC.
- WBTC, tBTC and cbBTC are examples of different wrapped BTC models; the interface has no partnership with them.
- Costs are a Bitcoin network fee on the BTC side, gas in ETH or the chain's native token on the EVM side, and any bridge fee shown in the quote.
- The interface is non-custodial: users send BTC from their own Bitcoin wallet and receive tokens in their own EVM wallet.
